summary: Converts a numeric error code a1 into a text string via sub_587DD0 (bounded to 127 characters), NUL-terminates it, and displays it in a MessageBoxA with the "Options Error" caption (aOptionsError). When a1 is non-zero it then calls UtilityFunction_9ca4(1) and returns its result; when a1 is zero it returns immediately with no side effects.

operations.description: Guard on a1: when a1 is zero the function returns a1 immediately and none of the error handling runs.
Format the error code a1 into the local Text buffer with a maximum length of 127 via sub_587DD0.
Force NUL termination of the formatted text by clearing Text[127].
Display the formatted text in a modal message box using MessageBoxA with a null owner window and the aOptionsError title string.
Call UtilityFunction_9ca4(1) after the message box and return its result.
Return the result of UtilityFunction_9ca4(1) on the error path, or a1 (zero) on the no-error path.
Called by sub_493C80 (0x00493C80), sub_497AD0 (0x00497AD0) and sub_497BA0 (0x00497BA0) on error paths.

unresolved: Semantics of UtilityFunction_9ca4's return value and its side effects are unknown.
